briefing: Stocks rose broadly today: the NASDAQ gained 2.1% and the S&P 500 gained 1.7%. Our past lessons say to use spare cash on strong up days, so I'm putting the remaining $445 into Amazon, a large and widely held stock where every buy signal agrees. All seven existing positions stay open, and their automatic profit targets and stop-losses keep running.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets like tech stocks, which pushes the major indexes up together. Today the NASDAQ rose 2.1%, a clear risk-on signal. Strategies that put cash to work on days like this, rather than on flat days, tend to catch momentum when it is strongest.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）指投資者信心充足，願意將資金投入科技股等較高風險、增長較快的資產，帶動各大指數同步上揚。今日納指升2.1%，正是明顯的風險偏好訊號。與其在市況平淡時勉強入市，不如在這類日子調配資金，往往更能把握動能最強的時機。

market_education.summary_en: Big tech and chip stocks led today's rally: the NASDAQ rose 2.1% and the S&P 500 rose 1.7%, which counts as a clear risk-on day. The screener backs this up, with many semiconductor and AI-hardware names (AMD, COHR, ONTO, ENTG, CRDO) showing bullish MACD crossovers and prices above their 20-day averages. No news headlines were included in today's data, so the specific cause can't be cited, but the move was broad rather than limited to a few stocks.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市全面上揚，納斯達克指數升2.1%，標普500指數升1.7%，屬典型的風險偏好（Risk-On）交易日，科技及半導體板塊領漲。從篩選結果可見，AMD、COHR、ONTO、ENTG、CRDO等晶片及AI硬件股普遍出現MACD黃金交叉，股價亦站穩20日均線之上，顯示資金正積極流入增長股。由於今日數據未附相關新聞，難以確定觸發升勢的具體消息，但升幅遍及多個板塊，並非由個別股份獨力推動。

trades.reasoning: AMZN shows all four signals together (MACD crossover, RSI 67.5 below 70, price above its 20-day average, and a volume surge), and at $272 it fits within the $445 of cash on a strong risk-on day.
